dauShare.label: Share of daily active users
dauShare.definition: Approximate share of DAUs derived from outside the U.S. and Canada region. Roblox defines a DAU as a user who has logged in and visited Roblox on a unique registered account on a given day; location is based on the IP address at registration.

ppe.label: Property and equipment, net
ppe.definition: Property and equipment, net, by geographic area (FY2025 10-K; in thousands of U.S. dollars). Mostly owned servers and network equipment in data centers, and leasehold improvements.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, property and equipment by geographic area
source.quote: Property and equipment, net, by geographic area was as follows (in thousands): … United States | $ | 762,181 | $ | 615,665

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1A (Risk Factors)
source.quote: For the year ended December 31, 2025, approximately 82% of our DAUs and 39% of our revenue was derived from outside the U.S. and Canada region.

sites.name: Corporate headquarters
sites.description: Leased office complex of approximately 806,399 square feet; the company relocated its corporate headquarters there on January 1, 2025.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2. Properties
source.quote: On January 1, 2025, we relocated our corporate headquarters to a new leased office complex in San Mateo, California. As of December 31, 2025, all of our San Mateo-based employees were based out of the new corporate headquarters, which consisted of approximately 806,399 square feet

notes: Roblox reports DAUs, hours engaged and bookings by region (US and Canada, Europe, APAC, Rest of world), but in its 10-Ks the regional values appear only inside chart images; the FY2024 Q4 Supplemental Materials (s27.q4cdn.com) were checked last edition and were the same. Those chart values were not transcribed, because a quote must be text in the document. The one text-verifiable regional user figure is the FY2025 10-K's 'approximately 82% of our DAUs ... derived from outside the U.S. and Canada region' (year ended Dec 31, 2025). Property and equipment, net by geography is at Dec 31, 2025 (U.S. $762.2 million, rest of world $122.6 million). The 10-K says over 200 of its 3,065 full-time employees were outside the U.S.; no country split is given. The 10-K describes 25 regional data centers across North America, South America, Asia-Pacific and Europe without naming or sizing them individually, so they are not sites. Besides the new headquarters, Roblox still leases about 427,271 sq ft at its prior San Mateo headquarters, partly sub-leased. Revenue by region is in the records and not repeated.
